variations.title: The rooftop dinner
variations.premise: She begs to go to a 'girls only' rooftop birthday dinner, Omar walks in with flowers and finds her with the rival, she mocks him as too broke for the menu, and a year later the host turns her away because Omar has booked the whole rooftop.
variations.script:
SCENE 1 — INT. COUPLE'S APARTMENT — NIGHT
The girlfriend, in a sparkly dress and heels, grabs Omar's hands and begs.
GIRLFRIEND: Please, please, please, let me go to the rooftop birthday dinner.
Omar grins and reaches for his jacket.
OMAR: Okay, I'll get a suit. We'll go together.
She snatches the jacket back, stern.
GIRLFRIEND: No, it's girls only. You can't come.
SCENE 2 — EXT. ROOFTOP RESTAURANT — NIGHT
Omar steps off the elevator holding a bouquet and scans the candlelit tables.
OMAR: Where is she?
At a table for two, she is kissing the rival, who wears a velvet blazer. She jerks back, panicked.
GIRLFRIEND: Omar, it's not what it looks like.
OMAR: Girls only?
The rival smirks and swirls his wine.
RIVAL: She begged me to bring her.
GIRLFRIEND: You're just a broke guy who can't even afford the menu here.
GIRLFRIEND: You're just broke.
SCENE 3 — INT. OMAR'S CAR / BEDROOM — NIGHT
The bouquet lies on the passenger seat. Tears run down Omar's face behind the wheel.
GIRLFRIEND (V.O.): …can't even afford the menu here.
He wipes his eyes and his hands hit the keyboard. Wordless montage, fast cuts: his first trade, a red day he shakes off, another late night, a bigger win, then the payoff.
★ fomo screen: Token chart down — a red day on his phone, the position reads -$420; he keeps going
★ fomo screen: Token chart up — another late night, the balance reads $2,180
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — the portfolio balance reads $348,920.15, on his phone, fills the frame
SCENE 4 — EXT. ROOFTOP RESTAURANT — NIGHT, ONE YEAR LATER
At the velvet rope, the host blocks the girlfriend and the rival.
HOST: Sorry, the whole rooftop is booked tonight.
RIVAL: By who?
The elevator opens. Omar walks out in a tailored suit, and the host unhooks the rope for him.
GIRLFRIEND: No way. Omar?
GIRLFRIEND: Omar, please take me back.
OMAR: Take you back?
GIRLFRIEND: I made a mistake, please.
He scoffs.
OMAR: Sorry, I can't even afford the menu here.
★ fomo screen: Home (rich) — on Omar's phone at his private table, fills the frame
OMAR: Want to trade like me? Download fomo through the link in my bio.
changes: The event is a girls-only rooftop birthday dinner, not a Halloween party, so there are no costumes.
Omar offers to wear a suit, and she grabs his jacket away from him.
He catches her at a candlelit table for two, with a bouquet in his hand.
The insult is that he can't even afford the menu here. The echo in his car and his final comeback follow that line.
The payoff is the host turning her and the rival away at the rope because Omar booked the whole rooftop. There is no car arrival.
A small host role is added for the door.

variations.title: The yacht party
variations.premise: She begs to go to a yacht party with 'her friends', Omar runs down the dock to see her kissing the rival on his boat, she says he'll never set foot on a yacht, and a year later Omar's superyacht pulls up and dwarfs the rival's boat.
variations.script:
SCENE 1 — INT. COUPLE'S APARTMENT — NIGHT
The girlfriend, in a white cover-up and sunglasses, clasps her hands and begs.
GIRLFRIEND: Please, please, please, let me go to the yacht party.
Omar holds up two pairs of sunglasses, smiling.
OMAR: Okay, I'll pack a bag for both of us.
She plucks his pair out of his hand, stern.
GIRLFRIEND: No, it's my friends' boat. You can't come.
SCENE 2 — EXT. MARINA — NIGHT
Omar jogs down the dock as a party boat pulls away, music thumping.
OMAR: Where is she?
On the deck, she is kissing the rival, who wears a captain's hat. She spots Omar and pulls back, panicked.
GIRLFRIEND: Omar, it's not what it looks like.
OMAR: Your friends' boat?
The rival smirks and toasts him with champagne.
RIVAL: My boat. She begged to come.
GIRLFRIEND: You're just a loser who'll never set foot on a yacht.
GIRLFRIEND: Just a loser.
SCENE 3 — INT. OMAR'S CAR / BEDROOM — NIGHT
Tears run down Omar's face behind the wheel.
GIRLFRIEND (V.O.): …never set foot on a yacht.
He wipes his eyes and grabs his phone. Wordless montage, fast cuts: his first trade, a red day he shakes off, another late night, a bigger win, then the payoff.

SCENE 4 — EXT. MARINA — DAY, ONE YEAR LATER
The rival's party boat bobs at the dock. A towering white superyacht glides in beside it and blocks out the sun.
RIVAL: Whose yacht is that?
Omar steps out onto the upper deck in linen and sunglasses.
GIRLFRIEND: No way. Is that Omar?
GIRLFRIEND: Omar, please take me back.
OMAR: Take you back?
GIRLFRIEND: I made a mistake, please.
He scoffs from the railing.
OMAR: Sorry, I'll never set foot on a yacht.

changes: The event is a yacht party on 'her friends' boat', not a Halloween party.
Omar offers to pack a bag for both of them, and she takes his sunglasses away.
He reaches the marina as the boat pulls away and sees her kissing the rival, who is in a captain's hat, on deck.
The rival reveals it's his own boat.
The insult is that he'll never set foot on a yacht. The echo in his car and his final comeback follow that line.
The payoff is Omar's superyacht pulling in and dwarfing the rival's boat, not a Lamborghini at the party.
